text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: My training for the Japanese Oaks has begun. 2,400 meters might be too long a distance for me, because it's really, really difficult to run…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: And then… my weight goes down. I talk to Trainer about it, and we decide that I should take some time off training.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I didn't want to worry Trainer, but I'm glad I came clean about it. Trainer is so kind, and even takes me out to eat!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Having this happen before the Japanese Oaks isn't exactly comforting, but I have to stay strong and work hard until it's time for the race.
